source_policy: Each success answer is a new combination of 1-6 directly reported fields from one issuer, one frozen v1 Oracle/fact contract, one statement, one period, one consolidation scope, one currency and one unit family. Each field inherits value, period, currency, unit, nil, comparison and receipt IDs from the frozen v1 assertion. No success case asks for a complete statement, cross-statement/period/unit result, or computed result.
